summary: Completed live backend and frontend regression testing for CloudWeaver. Auth, guarded dashboard, cost analysis, persistence, navigation, assistant, logout, and mobile sidebar flows passed. Google login correctly exposes the documented configuration-required failure.

minor.issue: Intentionally returns HTTP 501 until Google OAuth client credentials are configured; this is documented and not mocked.

action_items: Implement brute-force lockout after five failed login attempts if required by the auth hardening specification.
Make startup admin seeding idempotently update the existing admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Configure Google OAuth client credentials to replace the intentional 501 response before enabling Google login in production.
Add data-testid attributes to the two range slider inputs if they are intended to be directly automated.
critical_code_review_comments: Login currently has no failed-attempt tracking or lockout mechanism.
startup() only inserts an admin when absent and does not update an existing admin hash, contrary to the requested seed_admin update behavior.
Google button is a local error-state trigger rather than an OAuth initiation because credentials are unavailable; retain this explicit state until configured.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed registered user and one TEST API workload; data remains in the test database because no delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL tested at https://multi-cloud-planner.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin login, analysis expected Azure for the default workload, history, planner, settings, assistant, logout, Google error state, and mobile sidebar all passed. Re-test auth hardening and Google after fixes/configuration.
rca of the issue: The Google 501 is caused by the explicit /api/auth/google handler raising HTTPException(501) when OAuth configuration is not present. Missing lockout and admin password rotation are implementation gaps visible in server.py: login only checks bcrypt, while startup only inserts when no admin document exists.
